messages:
Anna (CS): mid-quarter cost health standup for Acme — token burn has jumped ~28% of monthly commit. Embeddings traffic spiked overnight. Anyone on onboarding pipelines? @Mike R
Mike R: saw huge spike from full-index backfill; we kicked off throttled workers yesterday and reduced batch size from 64 -> 16. Still seeing tail; will keep an eye. Pushed a config to staging.
Raj P: I'll run a quick run-rate forecast now. Rough numbers: current daily avg tokens 420M -> projected month $26.2k vs commit $22k. Shortfall ~4.2k (19%). Recommend budget alerts at 75% and 90% of commit.
Olivia C: noted. Renewal risk is rising if they hit overage repeatedly — they expect predictable bills. We should prep enablement on cost tuning (quantization + batching) and a short runbook for their engineers.
Anna (CS): action items: 1) Raj — full 7/30/90 day run-rate + one-slide summary; 2) Mike — attempt prefix caching for embeddings and test batch size tradeoffs; 3) Olivia — draft QBR cost one-pager and schedule enablement session with Acme eng lead. Can we target March 31 or April 6 for the QBR?
Mike R: testing batching patch now. Local bench: batch 8 yields 1.15x throughput vs batch16 for embeddings, but token cost down ~22% due to fewer retries. Pushed commit `git rev abc123` to staging.
billing-bot: Alert: acme-prod exceeded projected spend by 12% over 48h. Alert ID: BZ-1234. Threshold breached: projected_monthly > commit | 2026-03-18T04:12Z
Raj P: quick paste from forecast table: projected_monthly=$26,200; commit=$22,000; run_rate_factor=1.19. Net runway if no action: 0.82 months of spare commit.
Anna (CS): propose temporary policy: set soft throttle at 0.8 for non-critical routes and enable conservative batching for embeddings for 72h. That should buy runway and lower alarm noise.
Olivia C: I'll prep the one-pager and a 30-min enablement demo (slides + small knob-by-knob checklist). Will include a script for quantize->deploy and a short FAQ.
Mike R: :thumbsup: I'll flip the soft throttle in staging at 09:00 PT and report regressions. If all good, roll to prod with a 30-min maintenance window.
Anna (CS): perfect. I'll flag Renewal status as 'elevated' in Salesforce and loop in Zach S (AE) for customer outreach. We'll reconvene after Raj posts the detailed forecast.
Raj P: forecast will be in the thread by EOD. If anyone wants numbers sooner ping me and I can run an ad-hoc.
Olivia C: thanks all. I'll tentatively book Wed 03/31 10am PT for QBR and send calendar invites once dates confirmed.
